title: Malformed evaluation metadata aborts the entire evaluation run
reasoning: The validity check handles unreadable files and invalid JSON syntax, but assumes decoded JSON is a mapping and schema_version is comparable to an integer. Valid JSON such as null or [] raises AttributeError; a string or object schema_version raises TypeError. These exceptions escape problem selection, stopping the entire run instead of treating the checkpoint as requiring evaluation.
reproduction: Set a checkpoint's evaluation.json to null, or set schema_version to a string, then run evaluation without --overwrite.
recommendation: Validate the decoded top-level type and schema-version type before accessing or comparing them. Return false for malformed metadata so normal reevaluation can proceed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The schema-helper tests cover a missing version only. Their fixtures always contain a dictionary and use a correctly typed version when present.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand schema-validation scenarios across non-object JSON, invalid version types, missing fields, and valid metadata; assert invalid artifacts are selected for reevaluation without preventing other problems from being evaluated.
minimumFixScope: _is_evaluation_schema_current and existing schema-helper and selection tests.
